description: This Java source file defines an API resource class for managing internal external events in the Apache Fineract project. It provides endpoints to retrieve and delete external events, interacting via the InternalExternalEventService.

classes.name: InternalExternalEventsApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class exposing endpoints for retrieving and deleting external events related to internal processes.

methods.name: getAllExternalEvents
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all external events filtered by parameters such as idempotencyKey, type, category, and aggregateRootId.

methods.name: deleteAllExternalEvents
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove all external events.
